verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a UCP CLI, MCP servers (Catalog, Cart, Checkout, Order), profile/auth SDK-like tooling, and an AI Toolkit for validating GraphQL/Liquid/Extensions, giving AI-native developers substantial official tooling to build against. However, this is protocol/CLI/MCP-server documentation rather than a conventional multi-language official SDK library, and probes show no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt discoverability file, and no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs. missing for 10: language-specific official SDK packages (e.g. Python/JS client libraries beyond the CLI), OpenAPI/machine-readable schema, independent developer corroboration of SDK usability.
